data.exact_reserve_text: Included within the profit is an amount of GBP 26.8 million in respect of releases to reserves on 2012 and prior underwriting years (2013: GBP 10.8 million in respect of reserve releases from 2011 and prior underwriting years, excluding the additional margin discussed above).

prior_year_events.event_name: Reinsurance to close of the 2011 year of account
prior_year_events.impact_description: profit of GBP 30.8 million on business transacted in prior years inherited through the incoming reinsurance to close of the 2011 year of account

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a release of GBP 26.8 million in reserves for the 2012 and prior underwriting years, primarily due to benign claims experience. This contributed to a strong level of profitability for the year. Additionally, a profit of GBP 30.8 million was recognized from business transacted in prior years inherited through the reinsurance to close of the 2011 year of account.
raw_causal_phrases: releases to reserves on 2012 and prior underwriting years
data.data_quality_notes: There is a contradiction between the Chairman's Statement (page 3) stating 'releases to reserves' and Note 4 (page 14) stating 'increases to reserves' for the GBP 26.8 million figure. The Chairman's Statement's 'releases' was prioritized due to consistency with the overall 'benign claims experience' and 'strong level of profitability' narrative. No claims development triangle was found in the report.
